rationale: No supported optimization applies without violating a contraindication or reducing coverage. Dependency caching is already present via `actions/setup-node` with `cache: npm`, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is contraindicated (an equivalent cache already exists; caching build outputs is discouraged). The matrix builds standalone release assets for four OSes and already sets `fail-fast: false`; every platform binary is required for the release, so canceling remaining matrix jobs after a failure would drop needed artifacts, which matches the P-LIT-FAIL-FAST contraindication that every matrix outcome is required. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated for release/deployment work. No representative run-duration history exists to set a safe custom timeout, and standalone builds on Windows/macOS can be slow, so P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT risks false timeouts. Path filtering and workflow skipping are unsuitable for a tag-triggered release whose required checks must run.
